attributes.provenance: Built and measured in worktree GDL-Claude-ConstSweep, work_claim.constant-sweep.20260901.v1, commits adc292074..9153c85e7. Extends claim.law.SL_pool-constant-errors-are-score-invisible.20260901.v1 from a manual per-function audit into a mechanized image-wide sweep.

falsifier: Run cs_constsweep.py against the three pre-fix commits 416d91fbd^ (boss.c), d7ab494d3^ (sfx.c) and 97ff75c67^ (combat.c) with either detector disabled. The law is DISPROVED if a single detector reports all three known bugs, or if disabling the count-artifact (set-semantics), slide and granularity filters does not reintroduce the measured false positives. Conversely it is disproved if some fourth detector class is shown to subsume both.
subject: project:gdl
value: A MECHANIZED WRONG-CONSTANT SWEEP REQUIRES TWO COMPLEMENTARY DETECTORS AND THREE ARTIFACT FILTERS; NEITHER DETECTOR ALONE REPRODUCES THE THREE KNOWN BUGS, AND WITHOUT THE FILTERS THE FALSE POSITIVES OUTNUMBER THE FINDINGS. Measured while building tools/gdl/composed_census/cs_constsweep.py against the three known score-invisible bugs as canaries (ProcessSpewItems 8.0-for-32.0f gravity; ProcessEffects 0.5-for-0.01f collide radius; screen_limitation short OFF string), each verified CLEAN at HEAD and DIRTY at its own pre-fix commit. THE TWO DETECTORS. (1) SET detector: compare the SET of constant VALUES each side's function reads, resolving the target through symbols.txt + orig main.dol and our anonymous @NNNN pool entries through our own object's symbol table and section bytes. It catches the gravity bug, whose two sides differ in load WIDTH (target lfs 32.0f, ours lfd 8.0) and therefore never positionally align. It is BLIND whenever the wrong value also occurs legitimately elsewhere in the same function, which is exactly why it misses the ProcessEffects radius: a 2300-instruction function reads 0.5 in several places, so 'we read 0.5 and the target never does' is false at whole-function scope even though one SITE is wrong. (2) POSITIONAL detector: difflib over the two opcode streams, comparing constants only inside `equal` blocks. It catches the ProcessEffects radius at its exact site and cannot see the gravity bug at all. Both detectors catch the OFF string. THE THREE FILTERS, each forced by a measured false positive rather than chosen. (a) SET, NOT MULTISET semantics: under multiset semantics damage_enemy reported 'target reads 1.0, we never do' while BOTH sides referenced the SAME symbol lbl_80346810 with the SAME value, target simply loading it 8 times to our 7; bosscam's BossCamBossCalc was identical (4 loads of lbl_80345BF8 to our 3). A load-COUNT difference is CSE/rematerialization, i.e. allocator behaviour, and says nothing about meaning. (b) ANTI-SLIDE plus RUN DEMOTION on the positional detector: a constant-HOIST block is a long run of loads whose opcodes align perfectly while the two sides hoist different SETS, so the k-th load on each side is a different source expression and every pair reports. ProcessEffects produced eight consecutive such rows in which our value was exactly the target's PREVIOUS constant (target 0.5/ours 0.2, target 5.0/ours 0.5), with the int-to-float magic 0x4330000080000000 pairing against a real literal - proof the pairing, not the source, was wrong. Suppress a pair when either side's value equals the other's immediate neighbour in constant order, and demote any dense run of three or more mismatches within 0x80 bytes: the two real bugs in that TU were isolated by thousands of bytes. (c) SYMBOL-GRANULARITY guard on address-forming sites: dtk and MWCC disagree about where a datum ENDS. shop.c's target symbol lbl_80348440 is declared `size:0x1 data:byte` holding 'I' while our object carries the whole "ITEM" string at the same address, and btext.c/pb_objregs.c compared a 60-byte target table against our 2-byte entry. Compare address-formed data ONLY as NUL-terminated strings read from a fixed window - the NUL defines the end on both sides, which is what keeps the trailing-space "OFF    " vs "OFF   " canary visible - and skip any address-forming site whose datum is not such a string. SCOPE BOUNDARY, measured and deliberate: only R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 (always) and R_PPC_ADDR16_LO ON A LOAD name their datum completely. ADDR16_LO forming an ADDRESS does NOT - the register holds only a base and the selecting displacement lives in a later instruction - and enabling it produced 14 false positives across sfx.c and combat.c in one run, including the exact CONTAINER/CAM: pair that attempt.CB_screen-limitation-string-size-audit-and-reloc-arbiter-bounds.20260901.v1 had already resolved as a NON-defect. A coverage census confirmed nothing load-bearing is lost by the exclusions: the remaining unhandled EMB_SDA21 sites are stw/stfs STORES, and every 'unresolved' symbol is in .sbss/.sdata, i.e. a writable runtime global rather than a constant. FINAL OPERATING POINT over 257 units: 6631 target and 6614 our constant sites resolved, 53 positional candidates and 34 set candidates, against 75 rows correctly demoted as slide-suspect.
